name: Credit Transfer 13
definition: Payment instrument between a debtor and a creditor, which flows through one or more financial institutions or systems.

Debtor.name: Debtor
Debtor.definition: Party that owed an amount of money to the (ultimate) creditor. In the context of the payment model, the debtor is also the debit account owner.

DebtorAccount.name: Debtor Account
DebtorAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the debtor to which a debit entry was made as a result of the transaction.

DebtorAgent.name: Debtor Agent
DebtorAgent.definition: Financial institution servicing the account for the debtor.

DebtorAgentAccount.name: Debtor Agent Account
DebtorAgentAccount.definition: Identifies the account of the debtor's agent.

IntermediaryAgent1.name: Intermediary Agent 1
IntermediaryAgent1.definition: Agent between the debtor's agent and the creditor's agent.

IntermediaryAgent1Account.name: Intermediary Agent 1 Account
IntermediaryAgent1Account.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the intermediary agent 1 at its servicing agent in the payment chain.

IntermediaryAgent2.name: Intermediary Agent 2
IntermediaryAgent2.definition: Agent between the debtor's agent and the creditor's agent.

IntermediaryAgent2Account.name: Intermediary Agent 2 Account
IntermediaryAgent2Account.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the intermediary agent 2 at its servicing agent in the payment chain.

CreditorAgent.name: Creditor Agent
CreditorAgent.definition: Financial institution servicing the account for the creditor.

CreditorAgentAccount.name: Creditor Agent Account
CreditorAgentAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the creditor agent at its servicing agent to which a credit entry was made as a result of the payment transaction.

Creditor.name: Creditor
Creditor.definition: Party that received an amount of money from the debtor. In the context of the payment model, the creditor is also the credit account owner.

CreditorAccount.name: Creditor Account
CreditorAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the creditor to which a credit entry was posted as a result of the payment transaction.
